_comment: Context markers drawn on the monthly charts. Rate changes are derived from the target range automatically and are not listed here.

events.label: COVID-19 shock
events.description: Emergency cuts take the target range to 0–0.25% and the Fed restarts large-scale asset purchases.

events.label: Flexible average inflation targeting
events.description: Revised framework: the Fed aims for inflation moderately above 2% for some time after periods of undershooting.

events.label: Hiking cycle begins
events.description: First rate rise since 2018, as inflation runs well above target.

events.label: Regional bank stress
events.description: Silicon Valley Bank fails; the Fed sets up the Bank Term Funding Program.

events.label: Final hike of the cycle
events.description: Target range reaches 5.25–5.50%, where it stays for over a year.

events.label: Easing begins
events.description: A 50bp cut starts the easing cycle.

events.label: Tariff shock
events.description: Broad US tariff increases announced, raising the near-term inflation outlook and growth risks.
